description:
Spark SQL and PySpark DataFrame had multiple UAT failures: strict identifier
retry issues, missing `dual`, illegal Parquet `TIME(MILLIS,false)`, unresolved
TPCHavoc supplier columns, scalar-subquery grouping problems, and read
primitives expression failures.

anti_patterns.instead: keep changes scoped to the owning translator or loader path.

work_units.notes:
UAT log scan from /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_20260502
grouped failures into these owners:

1. Shared Spark-family schema retry: read/write/transaction primitives fail
   before load because run_spark_schema_creation_loop extracts a backtick
   quoted simple identifier (`region`) and rejects it under strict identifier
   validation. Evidence:
   - spark_read_primitives_0.01_20260502_203844.log:18
   - spark_write_primitives_0.01_20260502_203850.log:18
   - spark_transaction_primitives_0.01_20260502_203859.log:18
   Owner: benchbox/platforms/_spark_helpers.py and
   tests/unit/platforms/test_spark_helpers.py. This is the W2 target because
   it is shared, high-leverage, and narrowly scoped.

2. PySpark DataFrame Parquet loader/cache conversion: TPC-DS and coffeeshop
   fail while reading cached Parquet with INT32 TIME(MILLIS,false). Evidence:
   - pyspark-df_tpcds_0.01_20260502_213449.log:17
   - pyspark-df_coffeeshop_0.01_20260502_214615.log:11
   Owner: benchbox/core/dataframe/data_loader.py and
   benchbox/platforms/dataframe/pyspark_df.py.

3. Spark SQL TPCHavoc query-family compatibility: scalar subquery grouping
   and `dual` table references fail inside TPCHavoc variants. Evidence:
   - spark_tpchavoc_0.01_20260502_205250.log:93
   - spark_tpchavoc_0.1_20260502_205516.log:1358
   Owner: benchbox/core/tpchavoc/variant_sets/.

4. PySpark DataFrame read-primitives expression gaps: array aggregation,
   array length ordering, map/fulltext type construction, and missing window
   methods fail at query execution. Evidence:
   - pyspark-df_read_primitives_0.01_20260502_213500.log:13
   - pyspark-df_read_primitives_0.01_20260502_213500.log:28
   - pyspark-df_read_primitives_0.01_20260502_213500.log:144
   - pyspark-df_read_primitives_0.01_20260502_213500.log:167
   Owner: benchbox/platforms/dataframe/pyspark_df.py,
   benchbox/platforms/dataframe/expression_family.py, and
   benchbox/core/read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py.
